basics.name: John Walley
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior software engineer with 20+ years of experience building applications, libraries, and tools for developers across frontend, backend, and infrastructure. Deep expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, API design, and browser engineering, with a track record of creating reusable abstractions that cut complexity and raise developer productivity. Sets technical direction and owns complex systems end-to-end, from architecture and implementation through testing, deployment, and production. Combines hands-on engineering depth with product thinking and cross-functional technical leadership.

work.name: Cambridge Intelligence
work.summary: Senior engineer across developer experience, web applications, tooling, and high-performance graph visualisation SDKs, with a focus on architecture, developer productivity, and technical direction.
highlights: Co-designed and delivered a unified developer platform for multiple SDK products, consolidating X documentation pages, Y demos, and Z API reference pages into a single codebase and removing duplicated tooling across products.
Designed public APIs and reusable abstractions that simplified integrating and extending the visualisation SDKs for customer developers.
Transferred ownership of the Cloudflare-hosted website infrastructure from the Platform team to the development team, removing a cross-team dependency from every release.
Expanded Playwright end-to-end coverage with QA to approximately 90% of website functionality, making releases routine rather than risky.
Drove architectural decisions on application structure, testing strategy, developer experience, infrastructure, and engineering workflows.

Used AI-assisted workflows to migrate X documentation pages, Y demos, and Z API reference pages to the new platform, completing the migration in a fraction of the time a manual rewrite would have taken.

work.name: Mulberry House Software
work.summary: Ran an independent consultancy building data-driven applications and open-source developer tooling, owning architecture, implementation, infrastructure, and product direction for every engagement.
highlights: Created and maintain open-source React UI and data visualisation libraries, including [Allotment](https://allotment.mulberryhousesoftware.com/) and [Pennant](https://pennant.vega.xyz/), with 200,000+ weekly downloads and production use by the [Vega](https://vega.xyz/) trading network.
Owned full-stack applications and developer tools across multiple industries end-to-end, from initial requirements through production and ongoing support.
Shipped production systems spanning browser applications, Node.js APIs, cloud infrastructure, build tooling, and deployment pipelines.

Built interactive applications and data visualisation tools for clients including home-renovation startup [Reno](https://www.renovatewithreno.co.uk/) and pensions technology company [Financial Canvas](https://www.financialcanvas.co.uk/).
Balanced hands-on engineering with client collaboration, scoping, prioritisation, and product decisions across concurrent engagements.

work.name: Redgate
work.summary: Joined as a developer on tooling that streamlines SQL Server database deployment in release pipelines, then moved into product management for the same tool to work directly with users on adoption and usability.
highlights: Built features that improved the reliability and usability of database deployment workflows in production CI/CD pipelines.
Increased adoption and usability of the deployment tool through product and UX improvements informed by direct user research.
Introduced in-product analytics to support data-driven prioritisation, and worked with UX and engineering to define and rank features.

work.name: Sungard
highlights: Contributed to a scalable framework powering high-performance financial risk analytics.
Developed a tracing JIT compiler that translated C# financial models into GPU kernels, so existing C# models could run on GPU hardware without being rewritten.

work.name: Earlier Career
work.summary: Engineering and research roles spanning financial services, high-performance computing, scientific computing, and developer tooling.
highlights: High Performance Computing Developer at Fidelity, building computationally intensive systems for financial services.
Application Engineer at MathWorks, serving as UK technical contact for parallel computing tools and helping developers solve demanding computational problems.
Research Scientist at QinetiQ, working on multi-sensor fusion, object tracking, and defence systems.
